added.summary: CSS 2 floats: float (left, right, inline-start, inline-end) and clear (left, right, both, inline-start, inline-end) in a block's flow. A float shrinks to fit and is shifted to its side as high as it fits, beside earlier floats or below them; the lines of a text beside it are shortened (a line no word fits moves below it); a box that starts a formatting context of its own (flow-root, flex, grid, an image, a scroller) is narrowed beside it or moved below it; clear places a box below the earlier floats on its sides; a flow-root holds its floats, a plain block does not and its floats reach the boxes after it.
